items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Augusto Coen, and you recorded with them then.

ctx.x: And that didn't occur until the following year, thirty-nine. Right. Okay. So I know that you recorded and worked with Noro Morales, Xavier Cugat, Caney and.....

....Augusto Coen, and you recorded with them then. I just forgot the order that it goes in ahh, but I gather that you must have been very big to work with these bands because they were the top bands of the day. Now here you weren't singing for a while and bang, you come back into it and you start making recordings and working. Ahh, according to what they sent me from Finland, you recorded Cachita in 1940 with Xavier Cugat. I forgot the date, it was January something, January 14, 1940.
